== Introduction ==

Never use this deck, its for fun, yet it can win the game in one battle (not very often).

== Strategy ==

try and lure them to dantooine, anyway you can.  You can try and put put a lone Y-wing, to lure them to a beat down, but if you do this, you may want to add a few houjixs.
If you do get them to deploy a few ships to the system, Just put down your whole hand of ywings for free, hope to beat them.

If you somehow manage to beat them with this one battle, you will gain bragging rights to say you beat someone with a deck of 1 card.
have fun.
